text:
dana: quick sync: orchid9b-int6 econ+risk capsule for GTN. product wants a single-sentence rec and a short cost simulation for hybrid fallback.

sylvia: high level: int6 saves ~21% token spend vs our int8 baseline. latency p50/p95 on A100 cold: 100ms / 200ms. warmed-kv changes these numbers.

omar: measured numbers (cold-cache, avg seq=280):
```
cost_per_token: $0.00069
avg_tokens_per_req: 260
unit_cost_per_request: ~$0.18
tokens_saved_vs_int8: ~21%
p50: 100ms
p95: 200ms
KV_hit: 27%
throughput_per_gpu: ~12 rps
```

kevin: quality note: overall QA & short-chat parity. we see a reproducible drop in multi-document citation recall (~3.8 pts) and some instability in JSON schema outputs for API flows. longform summarization loses context in >3k token windows.

dana: product asked for a hybrid-fallback sim: route low-risk requests to int6, fallback to fp16 when "longform-risk" > threshold. what's the tradeoff curve?

sylvia: ran a quick sim using our traffic mix sample (chat 55%, RAG 25%, summarizers 15%, code/schema 5%) and fallback thresholds at 0.4/0.6/0.8. results:
```
threshold=0.4 -> fallback_hit=22% -> net_cost_delta=+3% vs all-int6, recall_preserve ~95%
threshold=0.6 -> fallback_hit=12% -> net_cost_delta=+8% , recall_preserve ~90%
threshold=0.8 -> fallback_hit=6%  -> net_cost_delta=+12%, recall_preserve ~86%
```

omar: note: warmed-kv reduces unit_cost_per_request ~12% and increases KV_hit to ~48% for chat prefixes; that lowers the net_cost_delta above by ~3-4ppt across thresholds. important to capture in canary.

kevin: mitigations suggested: 1) prefix warmstart + adaptive KV-ttl for hot customers 2) priming templates for citation retention 3) fp16 rescoring for schema/code endpoints 4) small constrained-decoding lexicon for citation tokens.

dana: product one-liner please (green/amber/red).

sylvia: amber  recommend gated rollout: enable int6 for chat/RAG low-risk requests with hybrid fp16 fallback for high longform-risk and hold full traffic for summarizers & schema endpoints until priming/rescore mitigations validated.

omar: ops: schedule two canaries: A) 5% chat with warm-kv true + tracking of unit cost, p95, KV_hit; B) hybrid-fallback experiment (threshold=0.6) with 3% total traffic and capture decode traces for summarizer slices.

ops-bot: canary scheduled: orchid9b-int6 -> 2026-10-05T16:00Z; A: 5% chat (warm-kv=true), B: 3% hybrid-fallback (threshold=0.6), region=us-west-2 :white_check_mark:

dana: sylvia/omar: please attach the sim script and sample traffic mix assumptions to the canary ticket. sylvia: pls include the warmed-kv sweep delta. i'll brief GTN with the amber rec and the sim table.

sylvia: will do. i'll also push a small example set of worst-case summarizer failures for GTN slides.

omar: i'll run warmed-kv perf sweep and post updated unit-econ numbers tomorrow AM.

dana: thanks all  concise and actionable.
